title: OneHitOre
description: OneHitOre is a Minecraft plugin that creates chain reactions when mining - break one ore and connected ores instantly shatter. Perfect for enhancing mining gameplay on any server.
body:
# OneHitOre - Ultimate Chain Mining Plugin ⛏️

Transform mining into an explosive chain reaction experience!

## 🔹 Description
OneHitOre revolutionizes mining by creating satisfying chain reactions - break one ore and watch entire veins collapse instantly! Perfect for servers looking to enhance the mining experience with physics-defying ore destruction.

## ✨ Key Features
✔ **Smart Chain Reactions** – Automatically breaks connected ores  
✔ **Version-Proof Design** – Works flawlessly from MC 1.13 through 1.21  
✔ **Natural Breaking** – Preserves Fortune/Silk Touch effects  
✔ **Performance Optimized** – Intelligent recursion limits prevent lag  
✔ **All Ore Types** – Supports every vanilla ore including deepslate variants  

## 📥 Installation
1. Download `OneHitOre.jar` and place in your `plugins/` folder
2. Restart your server - works instantly with default settings!
3. (Optional) Edit `plugins/OneHitOre/config.yml` to customize (future update)

## ⚙️ Future Configuration Preview
```yaml
settings:
  max-chain: 50            # Maximum ore chain length
  include-diagonals: false # Only break directly adjacent ores
  sound-effects: true      # Enable satisfying break sounds
  particles: true          # Visual mining effects
```

## 🔑 Permissions
- `onehitore.use` – Enables chain mining (default: true)
- `onehitore.bypass` – Mine normally without chains (staff)

## 🌟 Why Choose OneHitOre?
✅ **Instant Gratification** – Players love the satisfying ore chains  
✅ **Zero Maintenance** – Works perfectly out of the box  
✅ **Server-Friendly** – Minimal performance impact  
✅ **Always Relevant** – Automatically supports new ore types  

## 🎯 Perfect For:
- **Survival Servers** – Makes mining more exciting
- **Economy Servers** – Faster resource generation
- **Minigames** – Create explosive mining competitions
- **RPG Servers** – "Veinbreaker" ability system

**Satisfying ✔ Efficient ✔ Game-Changing ✔**

🔹 Watch your players enjoy the most addictive mining experience ever!

"The closest thing to real mining explosions without the lag!" - Happy Server Owners
